cells.title: Monthly Rent and Total Expenses (2026 YTD)
cells.code:
WITH 
  months AS (SELECT (generate_series('2026-01-01'::date, '2026-11-01'::date, '1 month'::interval))::date AS month_start),
monthly_expenses AS (SELECT
  (date_trunc('month', date))::date AS month_start,
  sum(CASE 
    WHEN account_code = '5010' THEN base_net_debit 
    ELSE 0 
  END) AS rent_expense,
  sum(base_net_debit) AS total_expense
FROM ledger
WHERE
  organization_id = '6eb2b567-f19c-56bf-bb3c-cdf0592ae97a'
  AND status = 'POSTED'
  AND account_type = 'EXPENSE'
  AND date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND date <= '2026-11-03'
GROUP BY
  1)
SELECT
  to_char(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COALESCE(e.rent_expense, 0) AS rent_expense,
  COALESCE(e.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  round(((COALESCE(e.rent_expense, 0)) * 100.0) / (NULLIF (COALESCE(e.total_expense, 0), 0)), 2) AS rent_pct
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_expenses AS e ON m.month_start = e.month_start
ORDER BY
  m.month_start
